# dsh-idea
English | 中文
A minimal IDEA in the DeepSeek Harness right column.
When several agents are moving several projects at once, the slow part is usually not the model. It
is the IDE you keep leaving for: another window, another index, another copy of IDEA per repo, and y
our grip on the code breaks. dsh-idea puts the files, the editor, navigation, and multi-repo Git in
the DeepSeek Harness right column. The agent writes; you read, edit, and commit on the same screen,
without jumping back to IDEA for a look. It runs in the PWA, adds almost no weight, and exists to ta
ke IDEA out of this workflow.

- Workspace file tree: browse by folder, and create, rename, or delete files and folders
- Text edit

ch file names, and search inside file contents

ation, and find references. A binary on `PATH` is used; otherwise the status bar says none is availa

ble
- JavaScript / TypeScript: `npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript`
- Python: `npm

install -g pyright`
- Rust: `rustup component add rust-analyzer`
- Go: `go install golang.org/x/too

ls/gopls@latest`
- C / C++: install `clangd` (usually with LLVM)
- Java: install `jdtls`
- Lua: inst

all `lua-language-server`
- Git: branches and history, diff, commit, pull, and push. The workspace r
oot is included when it is a repository. Immediate child directories with their own `.git` are liste

d too, and the panel switches between them
- Shortcuts: open the list from the status bar, click a b
inding to record it, or clear and restore the default. Bindings stay in this plugin and do not depen

d on another one
- Select text in a file and mention that range in chat with a shortcut (default `⌥⌘
I` / `Ctrl+Alt+I`). With no selection, the shortcut mentions the current file
